notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.5.1.v
notes.content:
Contract
Added a secundary slot on the contract payment.  

Victim soul coin cost reduced.  

Gold payment amount increased from 4 to 1, to 2 to 1. 


Quality of Life
The damage display now indicate flaws and traits.


Bugs & Fixes 
Fixed a bug that removed most of the "Resolves" upon reopening the game.

notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.5.0.v [REWORK UBDATE]
notes.content:
Victim Display (The City)
"Resolves"

A full rework of all the modifiers on "Resolves".

The "Resolve" frames/slots have been given a visual improvement.

Visual update on the "Resolves" tooltip.

"Resolves" no longer have costs.

A visual indicator has been added under the "resolves" for easier readability.

The visual of the filter has been improved.

Victim

A new brand set of Traits/Flaws on the victims.

Visual update on the victim's traits/Flaws.

Overall

Added a tooltip on the top Grief indicator.

Change the "Advance" text on the hourglass to the next grief.

Now you can offer a contract as soon as you have enough desperation.


Contract
The pentagrams have been replaced with a desperation sword to avoid confusion.

Curse/Blessing/Miracle costs only gold now.

Blessing no longer provides desperation.

Visual update on the Curse/Blessing/Miracle tooltip.

Only the valid offers will be visible during the contract stage.

Visual update on the stats on the right.


Home Encanment
The First upgrade no longer needs to be bought.

Enchanting a resolve no longer costs soul shards.


Quality of Life
The tutorial has been simplified.


Removed
Sins & Virtutes & Griefs matches have been locked

The church has been removed for the time being.

As well as notoriety/faith stacks.

Home Encanment

The case file has been removed.

The Shop has been removed as well.

Player health has been removed.

Soul shards currency has been removed.

Favority/Removed filter is no longer.

Golden Gate

Health restoration has been removed.

Erosion restoration has been removed.

Contract

Souls shards payment has been removed.

notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.4.2.v
notes.content:
Changes

[Home Encanment]

 The Death point has been changed to Death Rank to avoid unnecessary confusion.

 Added the 2 other Fusion device parts at the shop.

 Soul shards cost have been removed from Death's Resolve.

 Death's Resolve tutorial has been oversimplified.


[Church]

 Added blessing Rank marker.

 The last blessing now is +1 Rank higher.


Bugs & Fixes 

 Fixed, Death's Resolve can no longer be overenchanted.

 Fixed, Death's Resolve will be saved upon closing the game.

notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.4.1a
notes.content:
Changes


 Fixed Bug Map, now it stays closed when using resolves.

 Fixed Bug Damage/Cost display, It no longer enables advance button.

 Make it less likely for Resolves to get stuck.

notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.4.1.v
notes.content:
Quality of Life


 New visual improvements for the main Objective (Desperation Sword).

 Added Battle speed option in the options.

 Small visual improvement when dragging resolves.

 Now small amounts of gold are counted as well.



Changes



[Church]

 Removed church max stack.

 Change icon notoriety to lesser confusion.

 Resolve now increases church Rank.

 Now faith stacks are gained on any contract, before it was only the soul coins.

 The penalty for going to church sooner has changed and got a new visual.


[Shop]

 Shop prices have been reduced to avoid grind.

 Shop Items "War Declaration" now increase notoriety gains.




Bugs & Fixes 



 Fixed, Casandria tip display was displaying the wrong stats.
 Fixed, Blessing from Rank 3 not working properly.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.2.0

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Changes


 Fix some grammatical errors.
 Remove the cost of misfortune.
 Furnace Health cost Reduced to 1.
 Furance Resolve cost Rais to 2.
 Notority locked for the demo.
 Added a shelf to the contract panel.
 The "Deal" button at the end of the demo opens the steam page now.
 Remove some confusion about the "Death Preparation" requirement.


Quality of Life


 Now the Resolves, Soul Coin, and Shop items can be swapped more easily.


Bug Fixes


 Fix a bug that would make some tutorial overlap.
 Fix a bug that softlocks the player if it runs out of soul charges.



Special thanks to Babel Builder!
For showcasing the game and providing with feedback.
